# Lightfield | Core Use Cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Founders start selling | Use “List or Interactive Entry — Forming Customers and Opportunities — Advancing Phase — Triggering Next Step — Managing Reviews” as the main link to verify if the Founder Sales Start really reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended to record the data completion rate, first response time, overdue follow-up, phase stay, AI recommendation adoption rate, and cost per active user. |
| Automatically build pipelines from mailboxes | Use “List or Interactive Entry — Forming Customers and Opportunities — Advancing Phase — Triggering Next Step — Managing Reviews” as the primary link to verify that automatically building pipelines from mailboxes really reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended to record the data completion rate, first response time, overdue follow-up, phase stay, AI recommendation adoption rate, and cost per active user. |
| Customer voice for product team inquiry | Validate the customer voice for the product team to inquire whether manual maintenance is really reduced by using the "List or Interactive Entry — Forming Customers and Opportunities - Advancing Stage - Triggering Next Step — Managing Reviews" as the main link. It is recommended to record the data completion rate, first response time, overdue follow-up, phase stay, AI recommendation adoption rate, and cost per active user. |
| Outbound and Sales Operations Automation | Using the “list or interactive entry - customer formation and business opportunities - push phase” as the main link to trigger the next step - manage the double disk, to verify whether external calls and sales operation automation really reduce manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
